times.source_text: At 08:59 hours the northern interior storage was raised to 60 mm in one hour.

evidence.quote: At 08:59 hours the northern interior storage was raised to 60 mm in one hour.

times.source_text: At 09:41 hours the north coast and the north interior was raised to red with accumulated 90 mm in one hour, and 180 mm in twelve hours, until 18:00 hours.

evidence.quote: At 09:41 hours the north coast and the north interior was raised to red with accumulated 90 mm in one hour, and 180 mm in twelve hours, until 18:00 hours.

times.source_text: At 16:24 hours a new red-level warning was issued on the south coast by accumulation of 90 mm in one hour, and at 17:49 hours the red warnings of the north coast were extended until 20:00 hours.

evidence.quote: At 16:24 hours a new red-level warning was issued on the south coast by accumulation of 90 mm in one hour, and at 17:49 hours the red warnings of the north coast were extended until 20:00 hours.

times.source_text: At 19:47 hours the red warning was increased in this area to 200 mm in twelve hours, and its duration was extended until 22:00 hours.

times.source_text: At dawn a linear convective train (SCM29-II) was formed that extended hundreds of kilometers from the city of Malaga to the province of Seville with orientation NW-SE, which remained static until 13:00 hours and began to move towards the north, affecting mainly the area of the Guadalhorce valley.

times.source_text: On the 27th morning, yellow warning of storms and precipitation of 20 mm was issued in an hour in Sol and Guadalhorce and Axarquia, for the evening-night 28 and the 29th.

times.source_text: At night, yellow warning of precipitation of 20 mm was also issued in an hour in Ronda.

times.source_text: At 19:30 hours the yellow warnings of precipitation and storm in Axarquia were advanced to begin at this hour.
